name: wfe
description: Read the live canonical WFE-Next operator, project, goal, run, step, blocker, and accepted-result status from the local Victus WFE runtime.

interface.longDescription: Read-only access to the live canonical WFE-Next status on this computer. Shows current Projects, Goals, prepared Plans, Runs, Steps, blockers and accepted-result identity. This v0 plugin cannot run shell commands, mutate WFE, approve actions, or replace WFEKey.
defaultPrompt: What is WFE doing right now?
Show me active, ready, and blocked WFE work.
What is the current state of my WFE projects?
